$5+10+10+10$ [M1] Add 4 appropriate scenarios, with no incorrect or repeated scenarios; accept unsimplified and condone permutations.
$35$ [A1] Value stated WWW.
Method 2 — one A fixed and one L removed
${7\choose4}$ [M1] Accept ${7\choose h}$ for $3\leq h\leq5$.
${7\choose4}$ [B1] No other terms; scenario identified.
$35$ [A1] Value stated.
Method 3 — one A fixed and both Ls removed
${6\choose4}=15$ or ${6\choose3}=20$ [B1] Correct outcome/value for one identified scenario; accept unsimplified. WWW.
${6\choose4}+{6\choose3}=15+20$ [M1] Add 2 appropriate scenarios, with no incorrect or repeated scenarios; accept unsimplified and condone permutations.
$35$ [A1] Value stated.
